summary: Frontend-only QA of CR-002 (coupon engine-path), CR-003 (loyalty earn preview), CR-001 (branding), CR-008/009 (silent skip-OTP + discovery list) and BUG-003. Env loaded past skeleton on first/second load. Tested on mobile (390x844) with phone 9035133228 (Saurav, skip-OTP). Found one HIGH-severity runtime crash in handleApplyCoupon that blocks V9 and any manual Apply-button usage. All other engine-path, discovery-list, L-A guard, debounced re-fetch, 12-hr window labels, mystery-card and remove behaviours look correct. Loyalty earn preview is CRM-authoritative and drops/restores on coupon apply/remove.

Required intent (no 'Emergent' branding) is satisfied; the strict literal is only true pre-load.

pass_fail.CR-002 V9 Error-map priority: FAIL (BLOCKER-ADJACENT) — Clicking apply-coupon-btn triggers runtime TypeError: '(overrideCode || couponCode).trim is not a function' at handleApplyCoupon. React dev-overlay then intercepts pointer events and blocks further interaction. Repro: fill coupon-input with ANY code → click apply-coupon-btn. Root cause: button onClick passes SyntheticEvent as first positional arg, so overrideCode = event (truthy), and `.trim()` on an event object throws.

pass_fail.BUG-002 10-digit phone: PASS — '9035133228' entered on landing is accepted and skip-OTP flow proceeds without 'Please enter a valid phone number' error. User is identified as Saurav.

ui_bugs.issue: TypeError '(overrideCode || couponCode).trim is not a function' when user clicks data-testid='apply-coupon-btn'. The button's onClick forwards the SyntheticEvent as the first positional parameter, so overrideCode becomes the event object (truthy, non-string) and .trim() throws. React dev-overlay then blocks all further UI interaction. Impact: manual coupon-code entry is completely broken; only tap-on-card application works. V9 error-map case cannot be reached. Likely fix: `const codeArg = typeof overrideCode === 'string' ? overrideCode : couponCode; codeArg.trim()...` OR wrap button onClick as `() => handleApplyCoupon()`.

document.title is dynamically re-set to the restaurant name ('Kunafa Mahal') after menu load, overriding the static 'MyGenie'. Static index.html is correct. If CR-001 strictly requires runtime title='MyGenie', add a guard; otherwise acceptance intent (no Emergent branding) is already met.

integration_issues.issue: CRM /api/scan/auth/lookup is sometimes rate-limited (HTTP 429 'Too many lookups') during normal landing→menu→review flow. When this fires, the user is silently treated as anonymous — loyalty section flips to 'Points redemption unavailable' and L-A guard no longer blocks auto-apply. Not a code bug per se but surfaces fragility.

No toast element could be detected on either successful card-tap apply, remove, or (crashed) invalid-code apply. Either the toast library uses non-standard markup or notifications are silently skipped. CR-002 V8 'Coupon removed — Minimum order value not met' toast could not be visually verified.

issues: Coupon discovery list is hidden for anonymous diner who hasn't entered a phone — V1 anonymous auto-apply only reachable via the 429 side-channel. If anon diners are expected to see/apply coupons without logging in, the flow needs the strip to render for anon too.

action_items: FIX HIGH: Guard handleApplyCoupon against non-string first arg (event from onClick). This single bug blocks V9 end-to-end and any manual Apply-button usage.
VERIFY: V8 (reduce qty below min → coupon auto-removed with toast) after the Apply-button fix.
VERIFY: BUG-003 wording with a test account having loyalty balance < redemption min.
VERIFY: Toast implementation — none of the expected success/error toasts were observable via standard selectors ([class*=toast], [role=status], [role=alert], [data-sonner-toast]).
DECIDE: CR-001 runtime title — if 'MyGenie' is required at all times, prevent restaurant-name re-title; otherwise, accept dynamic title.
INVESTIGATE: Repeated 429 'Too many lookups' on CRM /auth/lookup during normal flows.
critical_code_review_comments: ReviewOrder.jsx handleApplyCoupon: `(overrideCode || couponCode).trim()` is unsafe — any truthy non-string (event, object) crashes. Add typeof string guard.
crmLookupCustomer should debounce/dedupe to avoid 429 cascades; currently fires on multiple lifecycle paths.
coupon-strip-container cards are horizontally scrollable but there is no visible scroll affordance (hint arrows) — some mystery/disabled cards sit off-screen until user scrolls.

Also toggle 'Use' on the loyalty row (data-testid loyalty-points-use-button) to verify Q3 (points redemption → earn preview reflects net earn base). rca of the issue: handleApplyCoupon is wired as an onClick handler on apply-coupon-btn. React passes the SyntheticEvent as the first positional argument. Inside the function, the signature `handleApplyCoupon(overrideCode)` then evaluates `(overrideCode || couponCode).trim()`. Since the event object is truthy, `overrideCode || couponCode` yields the event, and `.trim()` is undefined on it, throwing TypeError. Direct string invocations (auto-apply useEffect, coupon card tap) pass a plain string, so they work. Mitigation: change invocation to `onClick={() => handleApplyCoupon()}` OR inside the function add `const code = (typeof overrideCode === 'string' ? overrideCode : couponCode) || ''; code.trim()...`.
